About Time!

Incremental game about losing track of time in a corporate job.

You can have up to 5 gears.
To buy things, click on their price tag!

Use gears to increase your score.

Make the number go up!

foCs3 days ago

Very nice game, it has that satisfying roguelike and number-go-up experience you'd expect. Some feedback that i think would make the game even better:

- There are too little things to do in the endgame. In one of my runs, it was simply "just roll a bunch of effect modifiers and apply any X2 i see", but maybe it would be more interesting if some effects could stack together? Like in balatro you can stack card effect (sigil/bonus/mult) with the type of card (holographic/glass, etc...). Makes for even more engine building!

- Many jokers seem very hard to use, especially the type "if X is double than Y", especially since the clock numbers are shared for both minutes and hours. Gambling is fun, but with a limited amount of forwards, it's not sustainable in the long run, unfortunately. Unless you're in like round 50 and you've adjusted every number to maximize your chances.

But great game overall, would be interested if you continue development and add more variety, since the current base gameplay is very solid!!

for a more serious comment on why I think it is broken: fundamentally, the item either is absurdly broken or immediately kills you. You have to average more than 8 on both Hours and Minutes to come out ahead, and when you come out ahead, you come out VERY ahead. After like 2 rounds, this becomes "I can no longer lose" and it just gets sillier from there. 
While I like the idea of having an item that combines your hours and minutes together, this specific approach scales WAY too strong compared to every other gear in the game. I don't think there is a downside you can give this that makes this effect balanced, I think the effect needs re-worked entirely.
